fusions.name: Flash Expansion
fusions.desc: Bursts outward, dealing 10 damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles and knocking them back 2 tiles, and your movement speed rises 20% for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Parting Shot
fusions.desc: A thrown strike that deals 7 damage, up to 2 times that at maximum range. The target moves 25% slower for 2 seconds. It holds 3 charges, and each kill gives one back.

fusions.name: Bolt for Cover
fusions.desc: A burst of movement that carries you 4 tiles forward, and raises your movement speed by 20% for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: First to Notice
fusions.desc: When a non-fire blow hurts you, you regain 3 stamina a second for 4 seconds. Once every 8 seconds. You also have 5% more dodge chance.
